claims.statement: A generic detailed-balance/cycle-affinity/steady-flow design compiler overlaps 2026 CFT inverse/forward molecular-machine design and 2026 thermodynamic-space/chemical-probe bounds.
assumptions: bounded primary-source screen of Yang-Dill CFT and Liang-De Los Rios-Busiello thermodynamic-space sources
claims.novelty_boundary: Does not rule out a distinct harvested-flux extension with measured kinetic capacity and physical extraction; that extension was not built or cleared.
claims.costs: No control/compiler costs assessed because no implementation was attempted.
claims.falsifier: A primary-source result with the same explicit harvested-product, capacity, and acquisition interface would further preempt the candidate; a successful held-out design could support a narrower advance.
claims.next_gate: Search exact prior art and construct/test the harvested-flux compiler before asserting novelty.

claims.statement: At 523.15 K, a one-sided 0.3 to 0.8 eV activation-barrier error maps to a one-edge transition-state-theory rate factor exp(deltaE/kBT) of about 7.76e2 to 5.09e7 when its prefactor and reactant reference are fixed.
assumptions: CARE's reported 0.3-0.8 eV activation-energy uncertainty is interpreted as a one-sided error of one barrier
claims.novelty_boundary: Does not give a product-flux or selectivity uncertainty bound and is not CARE reproduction.
claims.costs: Requires per-edge uncertainty covariance, steady-state sensitivity or robust optimization, and measured product recovery to propagate to chemistry.
claims.falsifier: Recompute rates using the paper's complete correlated uncertainty model; this conditional multiplier is not applicable if reported uncertainty refers to a different quantity.
claims.next_gate: Acquire the frozen CARE case parameters and build an uncertainty-propagation/control prototype only if authorized in the next cycle.

claims.statement: CARE's published paper identifies rate/selectivity control and network pruning as future functionality; an experimentally calibrated compiler for harvested product flux versus energy and extraction cost is a candidate gap.
assumptions: the target interface requires collected product flux, measured kinetic bounds, and explicit process-energy accounting
claims.novelty_boundary: No claim of novelty, feasibility, new catalyst, or empirical performance; CFT, metabolic flux optimization, and robust microkinetics require further hostile comparison.
claims.costs: Feed/pump, heat, electrical input, catalyst/site loading, capture/separation, DFT and kinetic measurement precision must be charged.
claims.falsifier: A matched-information held-out catalyst/condition shows no robust selectivity-throughput gain after capture work, or prior art already supplies the same compiler.
claims.next_gate: Primary prior audit, obtain frozen CARE data/code, then attempt a constructive theorem/algorithm on a small measured network.
